in_marathi.name: Saarvik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saarvik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Saarvik is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Saarva', which means 'all' or 'whole'. The suffix 'ik' denotes 'lord' or 'ruler'. Saarvik is thus the lord or ruler of the entire sky. In Hindu mythology, Saarvik is the name of the god Indra, the deity of the sky and rain.
